answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a robust reef against Sybil attacks by tying voting power to capital rather than identity. An attacker must acquire substantial assets to exert influence, effectively pricing out malicious actors. Like a plume of smoke dissipating in the wind, fake identities fail to accumulate enough economic weight to sway the network. By imposing this financial yarrow, the system forces an attacker to bear the full cost of potential network devaluation, ensuring security through stake.
